Updated `GridItem` so those props are no longer required when used as a plain container in `portfolio-grid`.

### What I changed
- In `components/public/grid-item.tsx`, made `GridItemProps` optional:
  - `variant?: GridItemVariant`
  - `section?: string | null`
  - `setSection?: SetSection`
- Guarded button rendering so it only renders when all needed values exist:
  - `!section && variant && setSection && <ShowMoreButton ... />`

This resolves the error at `components/public/portfolio-grid.tsx` where `<GridItem ...>` is used without `section`, `setSection`, and `variant`.

### Verification
- `ReadLints` on:
  - `components/public/grid-item.tsx`
  - `components/public/portfolio-grid.tsx`
- Result: **No linter errors found** for those files.
- I also ran `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit`; it reports an **unrelated pre-existing** error in `components/test-session.tsx` (`@/lib/actions/auth` not found), not related to this fix.
- Running `pnpm lint ...` currently fails due to local ESLint dependency issue (`Cannot find module 'ajv/lib/refs/json-schema-draft-04.json'`), also unrelated to this change.
